latestVersion.changelog:
ai-subtitle-davinci-resolve 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Generate AI-powered subtitles and captions for DaVinci Resolve video exports (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV up to 500MB).
- Cloud backend handles subtitle creation and video rendering; no local install required.
- Supports quick video edits, subtitle burning, 1080p MP4 export, and timeline previews.
- Session authentication and credits managed automatically on first use.
- Clear guidance for uploading, exporting, and managing credits via simple chat commands.
